# Appendix E: Tool Usage

Working Group sessions were facilitated using [Zoom](https://www.zoom.com/),[^74] with collaborative notes taken in [Google Docs](https://docs.google.com/).[^75] [Draw.io](http://draw.io)[^76] and [Miro](https://miro.com/)[^77] were used for collaborative working and generating process flow and Blueprint architecture diagrams. Final process flow images were generated using [Claude.ai](http://claude.ai).[^78]

In line with the [RDA's Guidance on AI Tools Usage](https://www.rd-alliance.org/about/code-of-conduct/rda-guidance-on-ai-tools-usage/),[^79] Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Pro) was used for data analysis and writing assistance throughout this Blueprint. The model was configured to ensure that input and output data are not used for model training. All AI-assisted analysis and AI-generated text have been reviewed, validated, and edited by the authors and working group members to ensure accuracy and completeness.
